Sensor architecture: Fully stacked = fastest e-readout. Partially stacked = fast but not global.
RAW format: ARW 6.0 adds Compressed (HQ); ARW 5.0 is the older format.
Dynamic range (max): CineD lab measurements. Global shutter trades DR for zero rolling shutter.
Stills readout (approx.) †: Third-party lab tests (CineD / PetaPixel). Sony doesn't publish ms figures.
Max electronic shutter speed: Faster = less motion blur in flash-sync scenarios. Global shutter unlocks full speed.
Does 30fps mean same readout?: No. Burst fps = how often frames are delivered. Readout ms = how fast the sensor scans each frame. Rolling shutter only depends on readout speed.
AF/AE calculations / sec: More calcs = AF tracks faster-moving subjects more reliably during bursts.
Native ISO range (still): Global shutter requires higher base ISO — a design trade-off.
Phase-detect points (still / movie): Some architectures have fewer movie AF points due to readout pipeline differences.
AF sensitivity range: Lower EV = better low-light AF. Lens aperture affects achievable EV.
AF tracking response modes: Stable/Standard/Responsive lets you tune how quickly AF switches subjects.
Selectable release time lag: Lets you trade first-frame blackout for shortest possible shutter lag.
Flash sync speed: Higher sync = more ambient light control. Global shutter enables full-speed sync at any shutter speed.
Max EVF frame rate: 240fps EVF eliminates perceived lag for fast sports.
Max audio quality: 96kHz/32-bit float (with XLR adaptor) is professional broadcast standard.
Network streaming: RTMP/RTMPS/SRT live-streaming built in — no capture card needed.
Card slots (CFexpress A support): Both slots supporting CFexpress A enables faster write speeds and redundant recording.
Wired LAN: Built-in LAN enables fastest file transmission for news/sports workflows.
Wi-Fi standard: Wi-Fi 6 adds 6 GHz band for less interference and higher throughput.
Voice memo microphone: Photographer can narrate shot context during burst — useful for editors.
IPTC metadata embedding: Embeds caption/credit/location metadata directly into files in-camera.
Battery model: NP-SA100 is a new higher-capacity battery (2670mAh). NP-FZ100 is the standard.
Power draw — stills (EVF): Lower power draw = longer battery life per charge.
Charger in box: Some bodies ship with dedicated chargers; others rely on USB-C charging only.
